questions.text: Describe a plant or tree that you remember well.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a plant or tree that you remember well. You should say: what kind of plant or tree it is; where it is; when you first noticed it; and explain why you remember it so well.

questions.text: Have you ever grown a plant or tree yourself?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you ever grown a plant or tree yourself?

questions.text: Why do many people like to have plants in their homes?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a plant or tree that you remember well, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all plants and gardening. Why do many people like to have plants in their homes?
